summary: Added run_offline_report and four flags (--report, repeatable --journal, --registry, --report-format) to run.py, handled before any Device/Client, prompt, login or network. progression uses compute_progression_metrics; pvp uses battles_from_events + compute_scorecard; fleet groups events by account alias and adds audit_fleet with a registry. Missing/malformed journal or invalid registry exits 2; flag misuse is an argparse error. README.template then README.md gained an Offline reports section; the inventory lists the new flags. 9 tests in tests/test_offline_reports.py patch Client, Device, getpass and sockets to raise. Implemented by a subagent and re-validated by the parent.

contract_status_changes.before: Reports were library calls only; no command produced them from journal files
contract_status_changes.after: run.py --report prints progression, PvP or fleet reports from journals without logging in or touching the network
proof: run.py --report fleet with synthetic journals and registry exits 0

residual_risks: Fleet events are grouped by alias, so the audit's foreign-event rule cannot fire in report mode (documented).
docs/baseline/capability-inventory.md summary counts are stale; the release docs slice should refresh them.
